about: What the films of whosonfirst.ai are made from, and every cut made of them. This file says what each thing is and which is the latest. The files are in the R2 bucket named here; film-assets/README.md says how they are kept.

cuts.what: What `npm run social:assets` made before there was a film: the flow's page, a step to a frame. 1080 × 1350, 60 seconds.
The first pilot: the problem first, one step at a time, parties that take no part dimmed, and the caveat at the end.
Opens with the question, names the parties and the two things to watch, one idea to a beat, and what happens on the stage happens at the word that names it.
“JWT” is written as it is said, and the authorization server is off the stage when the copied token is tried again.
What a party holds sits clear of its box and on its line.
What a message carries travels along its line, a heading says what each part is, and a line at the end says the whole of it.
The last cut drawn as rows: what is sent eases, and the two things to watch are set evenly.
The first try at parties that stay put, with only what is sent moving.
A line is drawn toward the receiver before anything moves, the API stands level with the agent when only the two take part, and the look with depth.
The title says what DPoP stands for, “no proof” is no longer crossed by its line, and the keystore has room.

A closing line that says where the rest is, the request the flow is for held a moment longer, more room between things. The narrated files are the ones in which the address is said “dot AI”. The latest cut with the Kokoro voice.
